currentRoundInspection.scope: Two useful west/south and aerial pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. No bespoke survey, plan tracing, LiDAR or redistributed photographs.

pictures.observations: West/south front: very tall pale octagonal Gothic tower with stacked pointed belfry openings, ledges, corner pinnacles and open white spire; lower northern Bela tower has patterned steep pyramidal crown and small corner peaks. West rose/arched main door beneath pointed gable; south projecting entrance porch and selected tracery. Roofs carry orange/green/offwhite diamond/chevron bands. Exact figures and fretwork remain omitted.

Aerial from eastern/apse end: long main patterned roof, repeated cross-gabled chapels and narrow peaks on both sides, polygonal eastern apse with low buttresses; northern low chapel/service wings, small central dark ridge spire and paired east corner turrets. Tall southern clock/belfry/spire remains on west native+Z. Fisherman's Bastion, Holy Trinity column, cars and nearby buildings excluded from this individual church asset.
